title: medicago littoralis subsp. braunii
intro: Medicago littoralis subsp. braunii, commonly known as a subspecies of the bird's foot trefoil, is a flowering plant belonging to the family Fabaceae. It is reported to possess various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Medicago littoralis subsp. braunii include wound healing, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. However, further research is needed to fully understand its medicinal properties and potential applications.
